title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics + tool schema mapping and message formatting
author: Marisol Vega
description:
Summary: This PR updates the OpenAI compatibility layer for function/tool calling. It clarifies and implements tool_choice semantics (explicit tool selection vs. model decision), maps external tool schema definitions to Redwood's internal ToolDefinition format, and normalizes tool message formatting for cross-SDK consistency. Motivation: downstream clients expect OpenAI-style tool calling behavior (tool_choice and structured tool schemas), and current behavior caused subtle regressions for streaming + tool selection. See Linear ENG-4822 for the spec doc and ENG-4891 for the SDK compatibility follow-up. Changes: - Implement explicit `tool_choice` translation: OpenAI 'tool_choice' responses are surfaced as a first-class Decision in the runtime with stable semantics. - Add schema mapping layer that converts OpenAI-style JSON schema definitions to Redwood ToolDefinition (name, args_schema, required, example). This mapping handles nested objects and array-of-object schemas used by a few partner tools. - Normalize tool message formatting across SDKs: messages emitted during tool invocation are now formatted like OpenAI (role: "tool", name: <tool-name>, content: JSON-stringified args when schema present). - Backwards compatibility: old literal tool messages without schema are still accepted; we add a compatibility shim for older tool registries. - Tests: unit tests for mapping edge-cases, integration test that runs conversation + tool_choice flows in the compat harness, and end-to-end test with streaming enabled to verify message boundaries. Checklist:
- [x] Spec PR and design doc linked (Linear ENG-4822)
- [x] Runtime mapping implemented and covered by unit tests
- [x] SDK formatting helpers added (Python + TypeScript)
- [x] Docs updated with examples and migration notes
- [x] CI green after fixes (initially flaky streaming test, retried and fixed)
Notes: The description is intentionally prescriptive about mapping rules (see docs file path). No change to public Redwood HTTP API surface; changes are internal to the OpenAI compatibility layer and SDK helpers. Migration: customers using custom tool registries should verify tool schema compatibility; the new shim covers most legacy cases but complex union types may require small schema edits.
commits: spec(openai-compat): add tool_choice semantics and examples
runtime(openai-compat): add ToolSchema -> ToolDefinition mapper with nested object support
runtime(router): surface tool_choice decision in tool_router and routing logs
sdk/python: add format_tool_message helper and unit tests
sdk/typescript: add toolFormatting helper and update examples
docs: write openai-compat tool-calling guide and migration notes
tests: add integration test for streaming + tool_choice; fix flaky frame boundary handling
review_comments: Evan Carter (2025-11-10): Overall LGTM. Two small asks: 1) can we add a concise mapping table in the docs showing OpenAI schema -> Redwood field mapping for the common patterns; 2) confirm that required fields are enforced when the model returns a partial args object.
Marisol Vega (2025-11-10): Added mapping table to docs and enforced required-field validation in mapper. See updated docs file and unit test test_required_field_enforcement.
Lena Zhou (2025-11-14): Found a race in the streaming integration test where the tool invocation message boundary was split across frames. Suggest buffering until a full tool message is received.
Marisol Vega (2025-11-15): Implemented buffering fix in streaming frame parser and added regression test. CI initially failed on the flaky test; reran and it is now stable.

Samuel Ortiz (2025-11-20): SDK changes look good. One nit: the Python helper returns JSON strings for tool args; can we expose an optional param to return parsed dict for callers who want structured objects?
Marisol Vega (2025-11-21): Exposed `parse_args` optional arg in Python helper and added tests. Kept default behavior JSON-stringified to match OpenAI semantics.
Evan Carter (2025-11-29): Approving after requested changes addressed. CI green.
CI Bot (2025-11-30): build passed; tests passed; lint passed; integration tests retried due to previous flake and are now passing.
release_notes: OpenAI-compat: implement tool_choice semantics; add mapper from OpenAI tool schemas to Redwood ToolDefinition; normalize tool message formatting across SDKs; streaming flake fix for tool messages; docs and migration notes included.
notes_for_release: Operators: no runtime config changes required; new mapping is enabled by default for OpenAI compatibility mode.
SDK consumers: Python and TypeScript helpers available; see examples in redwood-docs for upgrade steps.
Edge cases: complex union schemas may need manual adjustment; contact support for assistance.
